high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "gabriellavignoni." The post features a person standing on a balcony with a scenic ocean view in the background. The individual is wearing a beige strapless top and a blue, sheer, fishnet-like skirt that reaches mid-thigh. They have long, dark hair adorned with a yellow flower accessory on one side. The person is also wearing a necklace with multiple pendants. The setting appears to be a tropical location, as indicated by the lush greenery, palm trees, and white picket fence surrounding the balcony.
